title: Global extended Čech model and its derived completion unit
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $\mathcal J\subset\mathcal O$ an ideal sheaf locally generated by finitely many sections. Use $D(\mathcal O)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] for the derived category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. An object $E\in D(\mathcal O)$ is locally derived $\mathcal J$-complete if $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal O_U[1/f],E|_U)=0$ for every object $U$ and every $f\in\mathcal J(U)$; here $\mathcal O_U$ denotes the ring sheaf on the slice site and $\mathcal O_U[1/f]$ is sheafified sectionwise localization. $C(\mathcal O_U;f_1,\ldots,f_r)$ denotes the extended alternating localization complex: its degree zero is $\mathcal O_U$, its degree $q$ for $1\leq q\leq r$ is $\prod_{i_1<\cdots<i_q}\mathcal O_U[1/(f_{i_1}\cdots f_{i_q})]$, and all other terms are zero. The differential is the alternating sum of localization maps, and its augmentation to $\mathcal O_U[0]$ is the identity in degree zero and zero in other degrees. For $r=0$ it is $\mathcal O_U[0]$. There exists a complex $K^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O$-modules with a chain map $\epsilon:K^\bullet\to\mathcal O[0]$ such that, whenever $\mathcal J|_U=(f_1,\ldots,f_r)\mathcal O_U$, there is an isomorphism $C(\mathcal O_U;f_1,\ldots,f_r)\cong K|_U$ in $D(\mathcal O_U)$ compatible with augmentations. For any augmented complex having this local description, the natural map $\eta_E:E\cong R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal O,E)\to R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(K,E)$ induced by $\epsilon$ exhibits $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(K,E)$ as the left-adjoint reflection of $E$ into the locally derived $\mathcal J$-complete objects. In particular $\eta_E$ is an isomorphism whenever $E$ is locally derived $\mathcal J$-complete.
